timeline.title: Royalty peaks at ~5.75% of net sales
timeline.detail: Royalty to Suzuki rose from 2.7% of net sales (FY08) to 5.75% (FY13), largely due to yen appreciation (royalty was yen-linked).
timeline.impact: ~5.7-6% of net sales; ~36% of pre-royalty profit in FY15 (IiAS)

timeline.title: Suzuki to fund Gujarat plant (SMG) instead of MSIL
timeline.detail: Proposal that Suzuki Motor Corp builds Hansalpur capacity via 100% sub SMG, selling all output to MSIL on no-profit-no-loss basis; MSIL keeps its cash for sales/service network (NEXA launched 2015).
timeline.impact: MSIL avoided ~Rs12,500cr+ capex; earned ~Rs5,600cr interest on saved cash (company estimate); market share recovered to 51.2% by FY19

timeline.title: Royalty on future models to be rupee-denominated
timeline.detail: At 2014 AGM company said royalty on all future models will be expressed in rupees, not yen.
timeline.impact: Reduced yen sensitivity; royalty ~5% of revenue FY20 (Rs3,820cr) and 3.4-3.8% of sales by FY24-FY25

timeline.title: SMG Contract Manufacturing Agreement signed
timeline.detail: 15-year CMA, approved by majority of minority shareholders; MSIL had option to buy SMG at net book value on termination.
timeline.impact: Gujarat-made cars recorded as MSIL sales; SMG costs sat in MSIL material cost and lease rent (depreciation) until amalgamation

timeline.title: Baleno launched; first exports to Japan
timeline.detail: India-only Baleno exported to ~100 countries incl. Japan.
timeline.impact: FY16 exports 123,897 (+1.8%); Europe exports fell

timeline.title: SMG Hansalpur Plant A starts production
timeline.detail: First Gujarat line (250k/yr); later lines took Hansalpur to 750k by FY24.
timeline.impact: Group capacity ~1.5mn -> ~2.0mn by FY20 -> 2.25mn

timeline.title: GST 1.0 implemented
timeline.detail: Small cars at 28% + 1-3% cess (29-31% total).
timeline.impact: FY18 volumes +13.4%; market share ~50%

timeline.title: Market share peaks at 51.2%
timeline.detail: FY19 domestic PV share all-time high.
timeline.impact: Share then fell to ~43% by FY23 (late to SUVs, small-car decline, diesel exit)

timeline.title: Toyota cross-badging begins (Baleno->Glanza)
timeline.detail: Suzuki-Toyota alliance: MSIL supplies cars to Toyota Kirloskar (Glanza, Urban Cruiser, later Hyryder/Rumion) - booked as 'sales to other OEM'; Toyota supplies Innova Hycross as Invicto (2023).
timeline.impact: OEM sales ~49k units FY22; 113,235 units FY26 (5.7% of domestic); 23,181 in Q1FY27

timeline.title: BS-VI transition and exit from diesel
timeline.detail: MSIL stopped diesel cars with BS-VI (1-Apr-2020); industry diesel share was ~20% in Q4FY20; slowdown + BS-VI cost inflation.
timeline.impact: FY20 volumes -16.1% domestic, net sales -13.7%, PAT -24.7%; DPS cut 80->60; later cited by company as a cause of share loss

timeline.title: COVID-19 lockdown (FY21)
timeline.detail: Zero domestic sales in April 2020; FY21 effectively 11 months.
timeline.impact: FY21 units 1,457,861 (-6.7%), exports 96,139; net sales Rs66,562cr; DPS Rs45

timeline.title: Semiconductor shortage
timeline.detail: Electronic component shortages disrupted supply through FY22, mainly hitting high-electronics models.
timeline.impact: FY22 domestic only 1,414,277; share fell to 43.4%; pending orders built up

timeline.title: CNG push
timeline.detail: Factory-fitted S-CNG extended to most models (15 of 19 models by Dec-25); ~70% share of passenger CNG market.

timeline.title: Exports scale up (Fronx/Jimny/Grand Vitara later)
timeline.detail: Exports more than doubled from 96k (FY21) to 238k (FY22); MSIL largest PV exporter for 5 straight years.
timeline.impact: Exports 238k FY22 -> 259k FY23 -> 283k FY24 -> 333k FY25 -> 448k FY26 (18.5% of volume; ~49% of India PV exports)

timeline.title: SUV offensive: new Brezza (Jun-22), Grand Vitara (Sep-22, strong hybrid w/ Toyota), Fronx (Apr-23), Jimny (Jun-23), Invicto (Jul-23)
timeline.detail: Filled the SUV gap that had cost share.
timeline.impact: MSIL SUV segment share 11.4% (Mar-22) -> ~20% Q1FY24 -> ~23% Q2FY24; SUVs share of MSIL PV sales 21% FY23 -> 25% FY24 -> 28% FY25 -> 29% FY26; ASP +15% YoY in Q2FY24

timeline.title: Kharkhoda (Haryana) greenfield - Phase 1 investment
timeline.detail: Site finalised; >Rs11,000cr for first phase (250k/yr); space for 4 plants / 1mn units. Board later approved Rs7,410cr for further expansion to 750k.
timeline.impact: Capex step-up from ~Rs7,500cr (FY23) to ~Rs8,400cr (FY25)

timeline.title: Board approves terminating SMG CMA & buying SMG
timeline.detail: Rationale: 4mn capacity by FY31, one ownership for flexibility; swap chosen over cash to preserve cash for ~Rs45,000cr capacity capex (total capex to FY31 up to Rs1.25 lakh cr).
timeline.impact: No change to volumes/revenue expected; profitability 'no noticeable change'

timeline.title: SMG acquired via share swap; 1.23 crore shares issued to Suzuki
timeline.detail: Board approved (17-Oct-23) purchase of 100% SMG for Rs12,841.1cr at net book value; paid by preferential allotment of 1,23,22,514 shares at Rs10,420.85 (allotment Nov-2023).
timeline.impact: Share count ~302mn -> ~314mn (~4% dilution); Suzuki stake 56.48% -> 58.19%; SMG became 100% subsidiary (consolidated from FY24)

timeline.title: Gujarat MoU for second greenfield (1mn units, Rs35,000cr)
timeline.detail: Vibrant Gujarat 2024 MoU; operation targeted FY28-29.
timeline.impact: Planned 1mn capacity, Rs35,000cr total investment

timeline.title: Manesar +100k capacity
timeline.detail: Added line for Ertiga/Brezza (CNG-heavy demand).
timeline.impact: Capacity 2.25mn -> 2.35mn

timeline.title: Debt MF indexation removed (Finance Act 2024)
timeline.detail: Deferred tax provision on treasury.
timeline.impact: Rs8,376mn one-time tax hit in Q2FY25 PAT

timeline.title: Domestic demand slump & heavy discounting (FY25)
timeline.detail: Small-car affordability pressure; discounts rose to ~Rs29-31k/veh.
timeline.impact: FY25 domestic +2.7% only; EBIT 11.1% (Q1FY25) -> 8.7% (Q4FY25)

timeline.title: Kharkhoda Plant 1 starts commercial production
timeline.detail: 250k/yr; Brezza first model.
timeline.impact: Capacity -> 2.6mn; start-up overheads/depreciation ~30bps EBIT drag in Q4FY25 and Q1FY26

timeline.title: Rare-earth magnet supply disruption (China export curbs)
timeline.detail: Flagged from Q1FY26; quantified at ~20bps EBIT hit in Q3FY26.
timeline.impact: ~20bps margin; supply-chain risk

timeline.title: e VITARA (first BEV) production & exports start
timeline.detail: PM flagged off at Hansalpur 26-Aug-2025; first ~2,900 units to 12 European countries; >13,000 exported to 29 countries by Dec-25; domestic launch Feb-2026; Japan supplied from India (Jimny/Fronx/e Vitara Japan exports crossed 1 lakh cumulative Sep-2026).
timeline.impact: Helped FY26 exports +34.6%; MSIL India's top BEV PV exporter; BEV 61/49kWh, BaaS Rs10.99 lakh

timeline.title: VICTORIS mid-SUV launched
timeline.detail: Indian Car of the Year 2026; fastest mid-SUV to 50k; 5-star BNCAP.
timeline.impact: H2FY26 SUV share of MSIL PV sales 31% (vs 26% H1); Q1FY27 SUV volumes +44.6% YoY

timeline.title: GST 2.0: small cars cut from 28%+cess to 18% (effective 22-Sep-2025)
timeline.detail: Announced 15-Aug-2025; sub-4m petrol <=1.2L / diesel <=1.5L moved to 18%, cess abolished (price -8.5% to -9.9%); larger cars 40% flat. MSIL passed on cuts plus extra price cuts (up to Rs1.29 lakh).
timeline.impact: PV industry -0.4% in H1FY26 -> +16.7% in H2FY26; MSIL domestic -5.6% H1 -> +12.3% H2 (Q3FY26 +22%); record retail 684k in Q3; first-time buyers 42% -> 54% (Q1FY27); small-car share up; price cuts -70bps EBIT in Q3FY26; 190k pending orders at FY26-end

timeline.title: SMG amalgamated into MSIL (effective 1-Dec-2025; appointed date 1-Apr-2025)
timeline.detail: Wholly-owned sub merged; financials restated. SMG employee cost/overheads move from material cost to natural heads; SMG depreciation moves from lease rent (other expenses) to depreciation.
timeline.impact: EBITDA margin regrouped upward (FY26 EBITDA 12.3% restated), EBIT ~neutral; no change to unit volumes or vehicle revenue; SMG cash/interest income now in standalone

timeline.title: New Labour Codes one-time provision
timeline.detail: Employee benefit provision in Q3FY26.
timeline.impact: -125bps EBIT in Q3FY26 (reversed QoQ in Q4)

timeline.title: Khoraj (Gujarat) land for second Gujarat greenfield
